author: IGN
description:
Look, we get it: if you love games but you’re not a game dev, the annual State of Unreal showcase can be a chore. Having to sit through all the powerpoint presentations about render pipelines and asset workflows in the scant hope of getting a glimpse at The Witcher 4? It truly is the most underwhelming finale to every Summer of Gaming. Well, if you just want to see all the new gameplay in retina-searing 4K without any of the faff, we’ve got you covered.

Here’s the full Gears of War: E-day technical showcase, complete with a fresh look at an Unreal 5 rendered corpser attack. Literal minutes of beautifully grimy first-person footage from No Law, Neon Giant’s follow-up to The Ascent. And a tantalising glimpse of how shiny the Rocket League cars are going to get when Psyonix’s ever-popular vehicular football tournament gets ported over to the upcoming Unreal Engine 6.

Oh, yeah, there was actually nothing from The Witcher 4. Sorry to get your hopes up.

#IGN #Gaming
title: State of Unreal 2026: All the 4K Gameplay

author: IGN
description: Get a look at Reveal Overview for Unreal Engine 6, the next core update to the hit video game processing and development engine developed by Epic Games. Unreal Engine 6 is focusing on implementing features to support the future of game development with support for larger game simulations, improved scalability across a number of systems, and more. Game developers and creators will also interact with new ways to operate and ship games with Unreal Engine 6, including LLM and Model-assisted workflows intended on creating improved efficiency during development and reduce tedious steps to heighten creative work. Improved gameplay architectures are also included in Unreal Engine 6, allowing for streamlined gameplay systems creations that work across multiple games with ease. Lore powers enhanced storage and version control systems to support next-generation needs by combining assets and source files logic to aid development teams worldwide. Unreal Engine 6 is set to release in Early Access i
title: Unreal Engine 6 - Reveal Overview | State of Unreal 2026

author: IGN
description:
Tor Frick, creative director at Neon Giant, stopped by Unreal Fest Chicago to show off more of No Law and how Unreal Engine has allowed this smaller team was able to create an "immersive, high fidelity shooter."

By using such tools as Nanite, Neon Giant was able to create certain pipelines that helped their artists handcraft spaces and ensure the quality was up to hteir standards.

MetaHuman, Lumen, MegaLights, PCG, and Niagara Data Channels also helped realize their vision for Port Desire, complete with NPCs that "react to dynamic lighting and a world that reflects the player's exploration."

#ign #gaming #summerofgaming
title: No Law - Tech Demo | State of Unreal 2026

author: IGN
description:
Unreal Engine 5.8 ships today, June 17, with experimental MCP server support, and this plugin enables LLM systems to "connect to and understand both the engine and your project."

In this demo, we switch from something as small as a living room in an apartment to an entire city, and see how you can use semantic search to bring your ideas to life, and even pull assets from your library to make these spaces reach your goal.

This even allows other developers to work on these projects in their own session, and it all is meant to work together, seamlessly. 

The plugin will ship with built-in exposure to such core systems as Blueprints, assets, levels, materials, meshes, and more, and developers can extend it with ease.

#ign #gaming #summerofgaming
title: Unreal Engine 5.8 - Experimental MCP Server Support Walkthrough | State of Unreal 2026

author: IGN
description:
Gears of War: E-Day took center stage at Unreal Fest Chicago, and Coalition showed how it is utilizing Unreal Engine to bring the world of this prequel to life in a way never seen before.

The walkthrough showed Marcus Fenix in the city of Kalona, but this time without the threat of enemies around every corner. Instead, this let the team show off the hundreds of light sources with MegaLights that "greatly improve the visual fidelity of everything from environment destruction to volumetrics and muzzle flashes."

It was also shown how all of these new tools allow the devs to iterate faster and increase per pixel-visual complexity without compromising resolution or framerate.

See how it all comes together soon, as Gears of War: E-Day will be released on Xbox Series X/S and PC on October 6, 2026.

#ign #gaming #summerofgaming
title: Gears of War: E-Day - Tech Demo | State of Unreal 2026
